posts.cooked:
After a few battles together, the heroes start to become a team, I think those teams should get a name. In this event, choose a three hero team from the heroes available in the app, there are 165 combinations. If you win three games with those heroes against three different villains, you get to pick the name of that three hero team. If you lose, you can keep trying until you get three wins. Let's see if all 165 teams can get names!

When you have named your team, please post the name and matches here too!

Form

Sheet

 

 

Also, don't forget to add the team to Event #21!
